spaces.name: Welcome
spaces.headline: Welcome to Awelen Entrepreneurs
spaces.desc:
I'm glad you're here. Awelen Entrepreneurs is a community for people who want to find, start and grow a business of their own, whether you're looking for your first idea or already leading a team.

You'll learn through short video courses, ask questions, book private coaching and meet other founders at live events. Please take two minutes to read how things work and the guidelines below. They keep this a safe and useful place for everyone.

rules.title: Be kind and respectful
rules.text: Treat every member the way you want to be treated. Disagree with ideas if you must, but never attack the person.

rules.title: No bullying or harassment
rules.text: Insults, mocking, threats, tribal, religious or gender slurs and unwanted private messages are not allowed. Such posts are removed, and anyone who repeats them is removed from the community.

rules.title: Ask questions freely
rules.text: No question is too small. Everyone here started somewhere, and your question often helps someone who was too shy to ask.

rules.title: Seek help early
rules.text: Stuck on a lesson, an idea or a payment? Post in Community, send Awele a message or book a coaching session. Don't struggle alone.

rules.title: Network to get more from your course
rules.text: Introduce yourself, comment on other people's posts and join a hangout. Founders who learn alongside others finish more courses and build stronger businesses.

rules.title: Share and celebrate
rules.text: Post your progress, what you learned and your wins, and cheer others on when they share theirs.

rules.title: No spam or hard selling
rules.text: No unrelated adverts, chain messages or get-rich-quick schemes. If you offer a service, apply to be listed as an affiliate expert instead.

rules.title: Respect privacy
rules.text: Don't share other members' phone numbers, messages or business details outside the community without their permission.

rules.title: Report concerns
rules.text: If something feels wrong, tell Awele through Contact. Reports are handled quietly and fairly.

courses.title: Understanding Economic Outlook
courses.headline: Read the economy before you bet your money on an idea
courses.sub: For new founders who want to understand how inflation, exchange rates and policy shape their business.
courses.desc:
Every business lives inside an economy. Prices, interest rates, the naira, government policy and what customers can afford all decide whether a good idea becomes a good business.

This course explains the big economic forces in plain language, shows you where to find reliable numbers, and helps you turn the outlook into practical decisions: what to sell, how to price, when to buy stock and how much risk to take.

modules.title: Module 1: How the economy touches your business

lessons.title: Why the economy matters to a small business
Inflation, prices and what customers can afford
The naira, imports and exchange rates
Where to find reliable economic information
Interest rates, credit and the cost of money

modules.title: Module 3: Turning the outlook into decisions

lessons.title: Pricing and stock decisions in an uncertain market

courses.title: Opportunity Recognition
courses.headline: Learn to see the opportunities other people walk past
courses.sub: For founders and managers who want a steady flow of good ideas for new products, customers and markets.
courses.desc:
Opportunities rarely arrive labelled. They show up as complaints, workarounds, gaps in a market or changes in how people live and buy. This course trains you to notice them, test them quickly and choose the few worth your time and money.

You’ll practise on real situations from Nigerian markets and leave with a simple system for finding, scoring and acting on opportunities in your own business.

lessons.title: Changes in technology, policy and lifestyle

courses.title: Financial Intelligence
courses.headline: Understand your numbers well enough to make better decisions
courses.sub: For founders and managers who want to read accounts, manage cash and talk confidently with bankers and investors.
courses.desc:
Many good businesses fail not because the idea was wrong but because the owner could not see what the numbers were saying. Financial intelligence is the skill of reading those numbers and acting on them early.

Taught by a Chartered Accountant, this course walks you through the income statement, the balance sheet and cash flow in plain language. You’ll learn to price for profit, manage cash, spot the warning signs and prepare the figures banks and investors ask for.

lessons.title: The income statement: are we making money?
The balance sheet: what we own and owe
Cash flow: why profit is not cash

modules.title: Module 2: Managing money day to day

lessons.title: The ratios bankers and investors check
Preparing for a loan or investor meeting

courses.title: Strategy Development
courses.headline: Set a clear direction and the choices that will get you there
courses.sub: For owners and managers ready to move from reacting every day to working to a plan.
courses.desc:
Strategy is deciding where you will compete, how you will win and what you will not do. Without it, every opportunity looks urgent and the team pulls in different directions.

This course gives you practical tools to understand your market and competitors, choose a clear position, set a small number of goals and turn them into a plan your team can follow and review.

lessons.title: Where to compete and how to win
Turning goals into a one-page strategy

courses.title: Leading Yourself First
courses.headline: Discipline, decisions and character
courses.sub: For people who lead others, or soon will.
courses.desc: Great leadership starts with how you lead yourself when no one is watching. Build the habits, judgement and character that make people want to follow you.

lessons.title: Leading when no one is watching

courses.title: Scaling for Impact
courses.headline: Grow the business without losing what made it work
courses.sub: For founders and leaders whose business is ready to grow beyond one location, one product or one person.
courses.desc:
Growth exposes every weakness: systems that only work when you are in the room, people stretched too thin and cash that runs out just as sales take off. Scaling well means building the foundations before you need them.

This course helps you decide how to grow, build the systems, team and finance that growth needs, and keep your impact on customers, staff and community strong as you get bigger.

lessons.title: Signs your business is ready, and signs it is not
Systems and processes that work without you
Building the team you will need

courses.title: Visual Thinking for Leaders
courses.headline: Think more clearly, and explain your ideas so people see them
courses.sub: For leaders who want to solve problems faster and communicate complex ideas simply.
courses.desc:
Leaders spend their days making sense of messy situations and explaining them to others. Simple sketches, maps and diagrams make both easier: they show you the whole picture and help your team see it too.

You don’t need to be able to draw. This course teaches practical visual tools for mapping problems, planning, running meetings and presenting ideas, drawing on product design and UX methods that work as well on a whiteboard as on a screen.

courses.title: Driving Change
courses.headline: Lead people through change so it sticks
courses.sub: For leaders introducing new systems, structures or ways of working.
courses.desc:
Most change efforts fail not because the idea was wrong but because people were not brought along. Resistance, rumours and old habits quietly pull things back to the way they were.

This course shows you how to make the case for change, plan it in stages, communicate it honestly, handle resistance with respect and keep momentum until the new way becomes normal.

lessons.title: Building a clear case for change

courses.title: Building Sustainable Wealth
courses.headline: Turn business success into wealth that lasts for generations
courses.sub: For founders and leaders who want their income to become lasting wealth for their families and communities.
courses.desc:
Earning well and building wealth are not the same thing. Without a plan, business income gets spent, tied up or lost, and families are left exposed when the unexpected happens.

This course covers the full picture: separating business and personal money, saving and investing with purpose, protecting what you build with insurance, and planning for succession and the next generation, with stewardship at the heart of it.

courses.title: Strategy & Business Model Renewal
courses.headline: Strategy & Business Model Renewal
courses.sub: Six-week Studio Sprint · taught by a Professor of Practice
courses.desc:
Seeing where the business really makes money, and where it should go next.

You work in a studio team of four to six on a live brief from a partner business, led by a Professor of Practice and supported by an Academic Facilitator. Expect about 6–8 hours a week: one evening masterclass, one evening studio session, a Saturday clinic every other week and your own team work.

A typical brief: “Our core product is stalling. Where do we grow?”

You're assessed on your portfolio (50%), the client's signed evaluation (30%) and your studio contribution and reflection (20%). Pass, and you earn the Awelen Practitioner Certificate in Strategy & Business Model Renewal.

courses.title: Executive Presence Foundation
courses.headline: Be seen, heard and trusted in the rooms that matter
courses.sub: Self-paced · six modules · 36 lessons · most finish in 8–12 weeks
courses.desc:
A modern finishing school for leaders, at your own pace. You’ll sharpen how you speak, write, negotiate, host, dress, show up on camera and hold your ground under pressure, across Nigerian, African and international settings.

Every lesson comes with a short video, a practical exercise and a workbook page. You get feedback through self-assessment checklists and from peers on the Critique Wall, and you finish with an online capstone and a Certificate of Completion.

Want live coaching? You can upgrade to the next Executive Presence Cohort and pay only the difference.

courses.title: Executive Presence Cohort
courses.headline: Ten weeks of live coaching with a small group of senior leaders
courses.sub: Live · 10 weeks · up to 16 participants · by application
courses.desc:
Everything in Executive Presence Foundation, plus live coaching on every module. You get personal video critiques from faculty, live roleplay, a 1:1 coaching session and live sessions with diplomats, media coaches, image consultants and CEOs.

Plan for about 4–5 hours a week: one 90-minute live session, the lessons, and recording your practice pieces. The programme ends with the Presence Showcase and the Presence Dinner, a formal evening in Lagos or Abuja. You can present your capstone online if you can’t attend.

Places are by short application to keep the group senior and well matched. Graduates receive the Awelen Executive Presence Certificate.

announcements.title: New: AMLD Studio Sprints and the Executive Presence Programme
announcements.body:
Advanced Management & Leadership Development is now taught in six-week Studio Sprints, led by Professors of Practice who have run businesses themselves. You work on a live brief from a real business and finish with a portfolio, not just a certificate.

The Executive Presence Programme is AMLD’s capstone. Take it self-paced, or apply for the live Cohort with personal critiques and the Presence Dinner.

Everything about both programmes now lives under Track 4 in the sidebar: the AMLD programme, Executive Presence and the Executive Peer-Circle.

announcements.title: Idea Discovery now has 5 modules and 32 lessons
announcements.body:
Idea Discovery has grown. It now runs from Finding Meaning in Life all the way to Exploring Your Idea Space, with 32 lessons in five modules.

If you have already unlocked the course, the new lessons are open to you now at no extra cost. Pick up where you left off.

announcements.title: The Crucible Circle is open for challenges
announcements.body: Organisations can now submit complex strategic challenges to the Ideation Room, and experienced practitioners can send an expression of interest to join as Expert Practitioners or Master Moderators.

announcements.title: Webinar: Pricing for profit in 2027
announcements.body: Join Awele for a live session on setting prices that keep you in business, with time for your questions. Register in Live events; your joining link is emailed before the session.
